g2-implement.title: G2 Leakage-safe in-season as-of cutoff (training + compound prior): implement
g2-implement.imperative: Dispatch implementer: add a leakage-safe 'train through eval-year round N' capability. (a) Gold-cycle data assembly: include eval_year events with round<=N in the TRAIN pool and restrict the eval/predict set to a target round range; thread an explicit as-of cutoff through session_classifications, recent-history form, and retro-truth label loading so NO round>N is visible to training. (b) Per-period compound-prior rebuild as-of N (only 2025 rounds<=N). Add config plumbing (a research/smoke-capable cutoff field; gold defaults unaffected). Unit tests at tests/unit/evo_predictor/walkforward/test_as_of_cutoff.py proving: with cutoff N, zero training events/labels/form/compound-observations reference round>N, and the eval set is exactly the target range. Use synthetic fixtures, NO heavy training.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

constraints: As-of cutoff explicit; no silent latest-value fallback
One canonical path; cutoff must not perturb gold defaults

g2-review.title: G2: review
g2-review.imperative: Dispatch reviewer (rigorous; leakage is the dominant failure mode): independently verify no round>N reaches training via ANY 2025 input path (classifications, form, retro labels, compound prior), eval range is exact, gold defaults unchanged, tests genuinely exercise the leakage guard.

g2-integrate.title: G2: integrate
g2-integrate.imperative: On APPROVE run verification; advance. On BLOCK rework (leakage findings block).

g3-implement.title: G3 Walk-forward orchestrator + leakage attestation: implement
g3-implement.imperative: Dispatch implementer: build src/evo_predictor/walkforward/ orchestrator that defines the 4 periods (P0 reuse promoted gold; P1-3 cutoff-train via G2 then fusion+calibration+materialize), predicts each period's quarter, aggregates the season fantasy score via G1, and emits a leakage attestation (per scored race: max train round < race round; compound prior built without that race). Add scripts/run_walkforward_backtest.py (full run entrypoint, --utilization passthrough) and scripts/verify_walkforward_run.py (exit 0 iff 24 races covered, each period-attributed, leakage attestation all-pass). Unit tests at tests/unit/evo_predictor/walkforward/test_orchestrator.py with the heavy training calls MOCKED (verify period boundaries, cutoff wiring, compound-rebuild invocation, aggregation, attestation logic). NO heavy training in tests.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

constraints: Leakage attestation is a hard gate the orchestrator enforces
Period 0 reuses promoted gold artifacts; verify config match

g3-integrate.title: G3: integrate

g4-implement.title: G4 Full-fidelity walk-forward run (heavy compute): execute
g4-implement.imperative: COMMANDER-EXECUTED (not a subagent — this is experiment execution, multi-hour). Run scripts/run_walkforward_backtest.py at --utilization max, period by period (P0 reuse; P1,P2,P3 cutoff-train at gold fidelity + fusion + calibration + materialize). After EACH period, verify its leakage attestation before continuing. Capture logs. Produce reports/walkforward/walkforward_2025.summary.json with all 24 races predicted, period-attributed, plus the season fantasy score. Attach run log + artifact manifest as implementer-result.

postconditions.statement: run complete; implementer-result (run log + artifacts) attached

constraints: Halt if any period's leakage attestation fails
